newsitem.title: KENYA: Port conditions update - Kenya - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Kenya - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

KENYA, Nov 27 - congestion has been causing delays at Mombasa's container terminal with three vessels waiting to unload yesterday. However the situation has improved since Nov 22, according to a Kenya Ports Authority spokesman, when seven vessels were waiting to berth. The congestion has been blamed on a go-slow last week by Kenya Ports Authority drivers, crane operators and other employees in dispute with management over salaries.
